name: commitwise
displayName: Commitwise: AI Commit Messages with Claude
description: AI git commit messages from your Claude subscription (Pro/Max) via Claude Code. No API key. Follows your team's guidelines, scans for secrets, and splits big changes into logical commits.

commitwise.claudePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `claude` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, common install locations, then the Claude Code VS Code extension).

commitwise.model.markdownDescription: Model passed to `claude --model` (an alias such as `haiku`, `sonnet`, `opus`, or a full model name).

enumDescriptions: Send a filtered, size-capped diff to Claude with no tools. Quick and predictable.

Like asking Claude Code in chat: Claude inspects the repo itself with read-only tools (git status/diff/log/show, read and search files). Slower but more thorough. Applies to "Generate Commit Message".
commitwise.mode.markdownDescription: How **Generate Commit Message** works. `agent` (default) gives chat-quality messages: Claude explores the changes itself with read-only tools (it can't edit files or run other commands; `.env` and key files are blocked). `fast` sends a trimmed diff to `commitwise.model` and takes a few seconds.

commitwise.agentModel.markdownDescription: Model for agent mode. Empty = your Claude Code default model (the same one chat uses).

commitwise.agentTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop an agent-mode run after this many seconds.

commitwise.timeoutSeconds.description: Stop the Claude CLI if it has not answered after this many seconds.

commitwise.guidelinesPath.markdownDescription: Custom guidelines file, relative to the repository root. Checked before `COMMIT_GUIDELINES.md`, `.github/commit-guidelines.md` and `.vscode/commit-guidelines.md`.

commitwise.guidelinesMaxBytes.description: Guidelines beyond this size are ignored (a warning is logged).

commitwise.useHistoryStyle.description: When there is no guidelines file, copy the style of the repository's recent commits.

commitwise.historyCommitCount.description: Number of recent non-merge commits used as style examples.

commitwise.ignoreGlobs.markdownDescription: Files whose contents are not sent to Claude (their names still are). Binary files are always excluded.

commitwise.maxDiffChars.description: Total diff characters sent to Claude. Larger diffs are shortened per file.

commitwise.ticketRegex.markdownDescription: Regex for a ticket ID in the branch name (e.g. `feature/ABC-123-login` → `ABC-123`). Empty to disable.

commitwise.useUnstagedIfNothingStaged.description: When nothing is staged, describe unstaged and untracked changes instead.

commitwise.secretScan.description: Scan added lines for secrets before anything is sent to Claude.

commitwise.optionsCount.description: Number of alternatives offered by "Generate Commit Message Options…".

commitwise.runInRepoDirectory.markdownDescription: Run the CLI inside the repository so it loads the project's `CLAUDE.md` and project settings. Off by default: the CLI runs in a neutral temp directory and loads no settings files.
